cards.title: While the model is paused
items: Model calls are paused since 2026-09-28 (CLAUDE_PAUSED = true).

A sent message still gets the first status line, then: 'The agents are paused for now, so I can't reply or create content yet. No credits were used.' Both messages are saved, and the message is given back to the month's allowance.
No tool runs: batches, drafts, inbox checks, images, publishing, to-dos, brand changes, handoff proposals and away cards are never reached. The conversation count still goes up.

Handoff Run answers 503 model_paused before any charge, and Majed's auto-run waits a day. The judge writes no scores and sends no alerts. Approve, Undo, Decline, and Save or Dismiss on a card still work, since they need no model call.

An added brand's setup in the Getting-started thread and the Generate page answer 'paused' before any charge; the /start setup check (no model call), and chat's trial-over and chat-message refusals, can still open the limit dialog.

cards.title: Refusals and limits
items: Chat refuses before anything is saved, in this order: trial over (402), too many in a short time (429: 30 an hour and 150 a day on a paid plan, 10 an hour and 30 a day on a trial), the month's allowance used (402), too few credits for a message on credits (402). The message goes back into the box.
Trial over, no credits or the agent's monthly cap: nothing is charged and the limit dialog opens. A paid plan's owner is offered a top-up pack first.
draft_items takes only social, whatsapp, ads and gbp; any type another agent owns is refused in code for Majed, the lead. Both before any charge.
An added brand's setup it cannot pay for opens the same dialog after 'Go, Noor' on /start, and (model on only) when the build starts in the Getting-started thread; nothing is charged.
A failed generation refunds the credits, a handoff Run too. A reviewer's flag holds an item for the owner even under auto-approve.

A turn that ends without a closing answer (model refusal, 5 calls, the $0.35 ceiling, a cut-off reply or out of time) still shows its item and brand cards and opens the dialog of any limit a tool hit.
A dropped connection retries GET /api/chat?conv= every 5 s, up to 40 times; if the reply is not found: 'Connection lost. Try again.'

cards.title: What the agents quote (model on)
items: The prompt and tool text take their numbers from the constants the charges use: TASK_COST, src/lib/pricing.ts and the media catalogue.
Batch costs include weekly_plan 2, weekly_report 3 and followup_seq 4; drafts cost 1 credit per item.
Chat messages: trial 30 once, starter 250, pro 650, business 1300 a UTC month, counted per account. 'Continue on credits' (paid only) bills a message at most 5 credits.
Plans differ in monthly credits and seats; brands are unlimited on every plan; the first brand's setup is free, each added brand's setup from its URL costs 9 credits, the manual form is free.
The trial is 3 days with 50 credits that do not renew. A chat image (default model) costs 1 credit; the image models in the inbox cost 1-2.

cards.title: Who can do this
items: Any signed-in role: open and send chat, batches, drafts, images, to-dos, handoff notes, thumbs and specialist threads.
Owner or admin: Approve, Add task on the plan card, publish through chat, and Save or Dismiss a brand change.
'generate' runs a handoff item and 'drafts' declines one; 'todo.write' saves or dismisses an away card.
Only the owner gets 'Top up credits', 'View plans', 'Open Subscription' or 'Open Governance' in the limit dialog; others get 'Ask the account owner…'.
